tldr: Mars through the 10th house brings focus to career, reputation, authority, and public contribution.
body: Mars transiting the 10th house energizes career, reputation, authority, and public contribution. For about six weeks, drive, heat, conflict, desire, and action move through this part of life, making it harder to ignore what needs attention here. This is an activation transit: it brings momentum and courage, but also heat that needs a clear outlet.
business: Mars supports visibility, leadership, and professional direction: make the call, update the plan, handle the visible task, and let the transit move something practical.
shadow: Impulsiveness, conflict, burnout, or measuring worth only by public success.
advice: Aim the fire in the 10th house deliberately. Work with career, reputation, authority, and public contribution without letting the transit run the whole room.
note: Authored from Marie Satori house-transit material.
